summary: Integrated Media Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 2, 2026, reporting the termination of Company Secretary Julie Ann Edwards (effective July 1, 2026, with no disagreement cited) and the appointment of Mr. Zhiyun Tan as her replacement. Mr. Tan, also a non-executive director and owner of a consulting firm, brings over 10 years of advisory experience. The filing includes board appreciation for Ms. Edwards. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a US Form 8-K Item 5.02. The change appears orderly and routine, with no disclosed financial terms, premiums, or structural complexity. Watch for any future governance shifts or strategic announcements that may follow.
